title: AppointmentLetterExtraction
description: Structured output schema for extracting information from an appointment letter or confirmation document.

appointment_type.description: Type of appointment or procedure (e.g., 'knee surgery', 'MRI scan', 'physiotherapy'). Null if not found.

appointment_date.description: Date of the appointment in original document format. Null if not specified.

appointment_time.description: Time of the appointment. Null if not specified.

location.description: Full location name and address. Null if not specified.

department_or_ward.description: Specific department, ward, or clinic name. Null if not specified.

clinician_name.description: Name of the doctor, specialist, or clinician. Null if not specified.

preparation_requirements.description: List of preparation steps the patient must take before the appointment.

instruction.description: The verbatim or near-verbatim preparation instruction from the document.

timing.description: When this step must happen (e.g., 'the night before', 'from midnight', '2 hours before'). Null if not stated.

items_to_bring.description: Items the patient must bring to the appointment.

medication_holds.description: Any medications the patient is instructed to stop or modify before the appointment.

accessibility_info.description: Any accessibility or support information mentioned in the document.

contact_info.description: Contact details for queries or cancellations.

additional_notes.description: Any other clinically relevant information from the document not captured above. Null if nothing significant remains.

extraction_confidence.description: Confidence level in the extraction. Use 'low' for poor-quality scans or heavily ambiguous text.

missing_critical_fields.description: List of fields that were not found in the document but are typically expected.
